description.summary: Bridges ICM42670 accelerometer samples to a BLE central over a DA14531 module connected via GTL over UART. The ICM thread hands each new 3-axis milli-g sample to the BLE thread through an event group; the BLE thread notifies the sample as a 6-byte X/Y/Z payload on the Sensor Data GATT characteristic whenever a client is connected. A companion Sensor Write Service accepts a Sensor ODR (output data rate) write from the client, in the 12-1600 Hz range, which the ICM thread later applies by reconfiguring the accelerometer. No lifecycle state machine, control struct, or status enum exists - the component is five free functions operating on module-level globals.

capabilities.capability: Hand off a 3-axis accelerometer sample from the ICM thread to the BLE thread via a FreeRTOS event group
Notify the current sample as a 6-byte X/Y/Z payload on the Sensor Data GATT characteristic when a client is connected
Skip notification silently when no client is connected (no status is surfaced to the caller)
Accept a Sensor ODR write (12-1600 Hz) from a BLE client and record it for later application
Apply the latest pending ODR request by reconfiguring and reopening the ICM42670 driver
Reject/ignore out-of-range ODR write requests (below 12 Hz or above 1600 Hz) without reconfiguring

executionModel.initialization: ble_init() (QE-generated app_main.c) opens g_ble_abs0, initializes the Sensor Service and Sensor Write Service GATT profiles, and starts BLE advertising. No dedicated init call exists in this component itself - it participates only through the two GATT service Init() calls and the BLE event group created before app_main()'s main loop.
executionModel.runtimeBehavior: The ICM thread converts each new I2C sample to milli-g and calls rs_ble_sensor_tx(), which stores it in g_sensor_accel_sample and sets BLE_SENSOR_TX_EVT_BIT to wake the BLE thread. The BLE thread's main loop, after project_logic()'s rate-limit/threshold gate, calls rs_ble_sensor_sample(), which copies the sample into the GATT wire struct and calls R_BLE_SENSORSERVICES_NotifySensordata() only if g_conn_hdl is valid; the call happens even if the peer's CCCD is disabled, in which case the FSP/DA14531 layer drops it on air. Sensor ODR writes arrive on the BLE thread via SensorRates_cb() -> rs_sensor_write_request_cb(), which only records the pending value (volatile flags, no I2C access); the ICM thread separately calls icm_odr_apply_pending() to re-run Open/InterruptCfgSet/MeasurementStart with the latest pending value, latest-write-wins with no queue.

useCases.useCase: Predictive Maintenance and Structural Health Monitoring

performanceCharacteristics.operatingRange: Sensor ODR is configurable over BLE from 12 Hz to 1600 Hz (values outside this range are silently ignored). Notification payload is a fixed 6 bytes (BLE_SENSORSERVICES_SENSORDATA_LEN), one uint16_t each for X/Y/Z, defined by sensor_data_fields.h.
performanceCharacteristics.customMetric: Fixed 6 bytes (3 x uint16_t). Not runtime-configurable; changing it requires editing sensor_data_fields.h and regenerating the GATT profile.
12 Hz to 1600 Hz, inclusive. Requests outside this range are dropped with no reconfiguration and no error reported to the client.

None on the BLE side for sample delivery - the BLE thread is woken only by the ICM thread setting BLE_SENSOR_TX_EVT_BIT via a FreeRTOS event group; the ICM thread itself is woken by the ICM42670 INT1 data-ready interrupt, not by polling.
None. rs_ble_sensor_sample() discards the FSP notify return status entirely; there is no status enum or lifecycle state anywhere in this component.
Static only. No dynamic allocation; the sample and GATT wire structs are module-level globals / stack copies.

resources.resource: One SCI channel in UART mode (GTL transport to the DA14531)
One I2C channel for the ICM42670
One external IRQ (ICU) channel for the ICM42670 data-ready line
One FreeRTOS event group (g_ble_event_group_handle) shared between the ICM and BLE threads
Static sample and GATT payload buffers

validationCase.validatedConfiguration: US159-DA14531EVZ connected via GTL over SCI0 UART; TDK QCIOT-ICM42671POCZ (ICM42670) connected over I2C at address 0x68 with INT1 data-ready on P301 routed to ICU IRQ channel 6. Verified GATT properties: Sensor Data characteristic Notify+CCCD only (properties byte 0x10, no Write), Sensor ODR characteristic Write with response (properties byte 0x08). Validated against Renesas GATTBrowser and/or Renesas Smart Console, using FSP 6.5.0 with FreeRTOS.
